REED_CARD_STRIKE.title: Strike
REED_CARD_DEFEND.title: Defend
REED_CARD_SPEAR_FLAME.title: Spear Flame
REED_CARD_SWIFT_THRUST.title: Swift Thrust
REED_CARD_ASHEN_BULWARK.title: Ashen Bulwark
REED_CARD_ASHEN_BULWARK.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Apply 1 [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies.
REED_CARD_DRAGONBLOOD_BOILING.title: Dragonblood Boiling
REED_CARD_FLAME_SHADOW_ART.title: Flame Shadow Art
REED_CARD_FLAME_SHADOW_ART.description: Apply {Cards:diff()} [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies. Draw 1 card.
REED_CARD_REEDS_SPEAR.title: Reed's Spear
REED_CARD_REEDS_SPEAR.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has [red]Scorch[/red], deal double damage.
REED_CARD_SEARING_PIERCE.title: Searing Pierce
REED_CARD_SEARING_PIERCE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deal {Cards:diff()} additional damage for each [red]Scorch[/red] stack on the target. Target gains [red]Scorch Immunity[/red] (no longer takes Scorch damage).
REED_CARD_FLAME_SHADOW_REED.title: Flame Shadow Reed
REED_CARD_FLAME_SHADOW_REED.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Flame Shadow Form[/blue]. At the end of each turn, deal damage equal to [red]Scorch[/red] stacks to ALL enemies.
REED_CARD_INFERNO_STORM.title: Inferno Storm
REED_CARD_INFERNO_STORM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and apply {Cards:diff()} [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_CARD_BREATH_OF_CALAMITY.title: Breath of Calamity
REED_CARD_BREATH_OF_CALAMITY.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Calamity Breath[/blue]. At the start of each turn, apply 1 [red]Vulnerable[/red] to all enemies with [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_CARD_EMBER_IGNITION.title: Ember Ignition
REED_CARD_EMBER_IGNITION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you have [blue]Ash[/blue], deal double damage and lose 1 [blue]Ash[/blue].
REED_CARD_SCORCHED_EARTH.title: Scorched Earth
REED_CARD_SCORCHED_EARTH.description: Apply [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies equal to the total [red]Scorch[/red] on all enemies.
REED_CARD_FLAME_INHERITANCE.title: Flame Inheritance
REED_CARD_FLAME_INHERITANCE.description: Transfer all [red]Scorch[/red] from the target to all other enemies.
REED_CARD_WILDFIRE.title: Wildfire
REED_CARD_WILDFIRE.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Ember Spread[/blue]. When an enemy dies, spread its [red]Scorch[/red] to other enemies.
REED_CARD_VICTORIAS_VOW.title: Victoria's Vow
REED_CARD_WITHERED_REVIVAL.title: Withered Revival
REED_CARD_WITHERED_REVIVAL.description: Exhaust a card in hand. Gain 1 [blue]Ash[/blue]. Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
REED_CARD_SPONTANEOUS_COMBUSTION.title: Spontaneous Combustion
REED_CARD_BURN_AWAY.title: Burn Away
REED_CARD_BURN_AWAY.description: Remove all your [red]Scorch[/red]. Heal {Cards:diff()} HP per stack. Gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] per stack.
REED_CARD_ASH_RESONANCE.title: Ash Resonance
REED_CARD_ASH_RESONANCE.description: Gain Block equal to your [red]Scorch[/red] stacks x {Cards:diff()}.
REED_CARD_SPARK.title: Spark
REED_CARD_ASH_STORM.title: Ash Storm
REED_CARD_EMBER_SHIELD.title: Ember Shield
REED_CARD_EMBER_SHIELD.description: Gain Block equal to the highest [red]Scorch[/red] stacks among all enemies + {Cards:diff()}.
REED_CARD_FLAME_BURST.title: Flame Burst
REED_CARD_FLAME_WHIRL.title: Flame Whirl
REED_CARD_FLAME_WHIRL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Deal {Cards:diff()} additional damage to enemies with [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_CARD_CREMATION.title: Cremation
REED_CARD_CREMATION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Consume all [red]Scorch[/red] on the target. Deal {Cards:diff()} additional damage per stack.
REED_CARD_EVERFLAME.title: Everflame
REED_CARD_EMBER_PACT.title: Ember Pact
REED_CARD_SCORCHING_BOND.title: Scorching Bond
REED_CARD_SCORCHING_BOND.description: Apply {Cards:diff()} [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies. Each ally gains {Cards:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
REED_CARD_UNITED_FRONT.title: United Front
REED_CARD_UNITED_FRONT.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]United Front[/blue]. At the start of each turn, apply [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies equal to ally count x power stacks.
REED_CARD_SCORCHING_CHARGE.title: Scorching Charge
REED_CARD_SCORCH_BURST.title: Scorch Burst
REED_CARD_SCORCH_BURST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Remove all your [red]Scorch[/red]. Deal {Cards:diff()} additional damage per stack.
REED_CARD_ASHEN_ARMOR.title: Ashen Armor
REED_CARD_ASHEN_ARMOR.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you have [blue]Ash[/blue], gain additional Block equal to [blue]Ash[/blue] stacks.
REED_CARD_SCORCHING_HEART.title: Scorching Heart
REED_CARD_ASH_GATHERING.title: Ash Gathering
REED_CARD_CINDER_SHIELD.title: Cinder Shield
REED_CARD_ASH_IGNITION.title: Ash Ignition
REED_CARD_ASH_IGNITION.description: Convert all [blue]Ash[/blue] into Scorch. Gain {Cards:diff()} [red]Scorch[/red] per [blue]Ash[/blue].
REED_CARD_SCORCH_BASTION.title: Scorch Bastion
REED_CARD_SCORCH_BASTION.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Gain additional Block equal to your [red]Scorch[/red] stacks x {Cards:diff()}.
REED_CARD_DRAGON_BREATH.title: Dragon Breath
REED_CARD_DRAGON_BREATH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Consume all [blue]Ash[/blue]. Deal {Cards:diff()} additional damage per [blue]Ash[/blue].
REED_CARD_CINDER_SPEAR_COMBO.title: Cinder Spear Combo
REED_CARD_CINDER_SPEAR_COMBO.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage 3 times. Apply {Cards:diff()} [red]Scorch[/red] each hit.
REED_CARD_BURN_OUT.title: Burn Out
REED_CARD_BURN_OUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If target has {Cards:diff()} or more [red]Scorch[/red], deal 12 additional damage and remove all [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_CARD_EMBER_EYE.title: Ember Eye
REED_CARD_EMBER_EYE.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. If any drawn card is Scorch-related, lose 1 HP.
REED_CARD_ASH_BATH.title: Ash Bath
REED_CARD_ASH_BATH.description: Remove all your [red]Scorch[/red]. Heal {Cards:diff()} HP per stack. Gain [blue]Ash[/blue] equal to the removed stacks.
REED_CARD_EMBER_CONDUIT.title: Ember Conduit
REED_CARD_SCORCHED_EARTH_PROTOCOL.title: Scorched Earth Protocol
REED_CARD_SCORCHED_EARTH_PROTOCOL.descri: Exhaust all non-Attack, non-Skill cards in hand. Gain {Cards:diff()} energy per card.
REED_CARD_DRAGONS_LEGACY.title: Dragon's Legacy
REED_CARD_DRAGONS_LEGACY.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Dragon's Legacy[/blue]. At the start of each turn, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and apply 1 [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies.
REED_CARD_ASH_RECOVERY.title: Ash Recovery
REED_CARD_ASH_RECOVERY.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Ash Recovery[/blue]. Whenever you Exhaust a card, heal 1 HP.
REED_CARD_ETERNAL_EMBER.title: Eternal Ember
REED_CARD_ETERNAL_EMBER.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Eternal Ember[/blue]. At the start of each turn, apply 3 [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies and gain Block equal to total [red]Scorch[/red] on all enemies.
REED_CARD_FLAME_TORRENT.title: Flame Torrent
REED_CARD_FLAME_TORRENT.description: Apply [red]Spell Vulnerable[/red] to ALL enemies equal to their current [red]Scorch[/red] stacks. Then apply [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies equal to their current [red]Spell Vulnerable[/red] stacks.
REED_CARD_SPELL_BREATH.title: Spell Breath
REED_CARD_EMBER_SCALES.title: Ember Scales
REED_CARD_EMBER_SCALES.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Gain an additional {Cards:diff()} Block for each enemy with [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_CARD_ASH_EMBRACE.title: Ashen Embrace
REED_CARD_ASH_EMBRACE.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Ashen Embrace[/blue]. At the start of each turn, gain Block equal to [blue]Ash[/blue] stacks x stacks.
REED_CARD_SCORCH_DETONATION.title: Detonation
REED_CARD_SCORCH_DETONATION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deal an additional {Cards:diff()} damage for each stack of [red]Scorch[/red] on the target, then remove all its [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_CARD_BACKDRAFT.title: Backdraft
REED_CARD_BACKDRAFT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies, plus {Cards:diff()} for each stack of your [red]Scorch Counter[/red], then Exhaust all your [red]Scorch Counters[/red].
REED_CARD_EMBER_AFTERGLOW.title: Ember Afterglow
REED_CARD_EMBER_AFTERGLOW.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Ember Afterglow[/blue]. Whenever a card is Exhausted, draw 1 card (max {Cards} per turn).
REED_CARD_RESIDUAL_WARMTH.title: Residual Warmth
REED_CARD_RESIDUAL_WARMTH.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s). Draw 1 additional card if you have any [red]Scorch Counters[/red].
REED_CARD_MARTYR_FLAME.title: Martyr's Flame
REED_CARD_MARTYR_FLAME.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply 1 [blue]Ember Spread[/blue] to the target (when it dies, its [red]Scorch[/red] is spread to other enemies).
REED_CARD_DRAGONS_MAJESTY.title: Dragonborn Majesty
REED_CARD_DRAGONS_MAJESTY.description: Gain {Cards} [blue]Dragonborn Majesty[/blue]. At the start of each turn, apply the same number of stacks of [red]Weak[/red] to every enemy with [red]Scorch[/red].
